notes: בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית: the preposition is unrepresented because the ASV writes the third time as a bare adverbial (rule 40), while the assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12) and the substantival ordinal takes its supplied generic time, headed on third (rule 31).
קֹרֵא לַנַּעַר is rendered called the child with a bare object, so the לְ is unrepresented and the assimilated article takes the written the (rules 12, 40).
יָסַף is rule 56's adverbially rendered auxiliary verb, discontinuous from the infinitive that holds the predicate.
